aristo sham.draw: Won the Gold Medal and Audience Award at the 2025 Van Cliburn International Piano Competition, has soloed with the London Symphony under Simon Rattle and other major orchestras, and is now on a Cliburn-managed international concert tour.

patty griffin.draw: Two-time Grammy winner and 2026 nominee, Americana Music Association Artist of the Year and Lifetime Achievement honoree, headlining national and international tours of theaters and performing-arts centers.

summer evening for the arts by the sherm.displayName: Summer Evening for the Arts by the Sherman Artists
summer evening for the arts by the sherm.draw: A Sherman Artists Association fundraiser (their first-ever event to establish a permanent Sherman Art Center) featuring live music, food, drink, and live/silent auctions; no named headlining musical act, so draw is local community-arts scale.
summer evening for the arts by the sherm.exampleTitle: "Summer Evening for the Arts" by the Sherman Artists Association

the clams.draw: Greenwich, CT classic-rock/Motown/funk cover band (formed 2013) with a modest profile (~338 Facebook followers) that plays private parties, club gigs, and local events like the Greenwich Town Party local-band slot and the Last Taste of Summer Craft Beer Festival; no casino/theater/festival headlining, national bills, or press found.

second saturday at kent barns.draw: Established monthly arts-and-market series (May–Oct) at the revitalized Kent Barns complex with NYC-style galleries, pop-ups, and ambient live music, a recognized Litchfield County destination covered by regional press, but not a named headlining music act.

summerfest the wild wild west.draw: Annual Litchfield Community Center fundraiser gala billed locally as "the most anticipated event of the year" with live music, local food/beverage and sponsorship tiers, but no named band or headlining act is advertised.

simply stapleton the ultimate chris stap.displayName: Simply Stapleton - The Ultimate Chris Stapleton Tribute
simply stapleton the ultimate chris stap.draw: NY-based six-piece Chris Stapleton tribute booked across recognized regional rooms (Daryl's House Club, Garcia's at The Capitol Theatre in Port Chester, CM Performing Arts Center, Jones Beach Boardwalk Bandshell), signaling a real regional tribute following though no casino/festival headlining or national opening slots surfaced.
simply stapleton the ultimate chris stap.exampleTitle: Simply Stapleton - The Ultimate Chris Stapleton Tribute

on the trax.draw: Booked as a July act in the free CityCenter Danbury Summer Concert Series on the Green, but no findable social following, venue history, national opening slots, charting, or press for the act itself.
on the trax.exampleTitle: Danbury CityCenter Summer Concert Series — On The Trail

the pears.draw: Local Western CT acoustic trio (Nancy Janutolo, Angela Cahill, Chuck Cundari) that played ~50 gigs a year around New Milford from 2010-2014 with a strong local following, now returning for repeat performances at the JCC in Sherman; no casino/theater, festival, national-opener, or charting credits found.

clark eno band.draw: Long-running Danbury-based professional dance/swing ensemble (Clark Eno Orchestra) led by drummer Clark Eno, with credits including First Night Manhattan at Lincoln Center's NY State Theater, NYC's Midsummer Night Swing series, and the Bermuda Jazz Festival, and a strong regional wedding/event following.

apollo s fire.draw: Grammy-winning (2019, "Songs of Orpheus") Cleveland/Chicago baroque orchestra led by Jeannette Sorrell, with 24M+ YouTube views, sold-out Carnegie Hall and BBC Proms appearances, 7 European tours, and New York Times/New Yorker acclaim as "the USA's hottest baroque band."

guy tino.draw: Veteran solo singer-guitarist (30+ years, 300+ song book) from nearby Brookfield who fronted CT blues/rock band The Providers, which opened for NRBQ, Johnny Winter, and John Mayall at Toad's Place; now a steady regional bar/restaurant act rather than a ticketed draw.

canyon lights handsome jack.draw: Two label-backed touring blues-rock acts: Handsome Jack (Alive Naturalsound Records; shared bills with Gov't Mule, The Hold Steady, J. Geils) and Canyon Lights (touring trio of GA-20 alumni, a three-time #1 Billboard blues-chart band).

american string quartet bernat.draw: Internationally acclaimed touring quartet, resident at Manhattan School of Music since 1984 and 1974 Naumburg First Prize winner, with landmark complete Mozart/Beethoven/Bartok recordings on a matched Stradivarius set, headlining the Yale-affiliated Norfolk Chamber Music Festival.

waterbury symphony orchestra 37th annual.displayName: Waterbury Symphony Orchestra (37th Annual Picnic & Pops)
waterbury symphony orchestra 37th annual.draw: Professional regional orchestra in its 87th season under conductor Leif Bjaland, running a 37-year Picnic & Pops tradition in NW Connecticut and booking national-caliber guests like pianist Garrick Ohlsson.

trombone shorty orleans avenue.draw: Grammy-winning New Orleans funk/jazz headliner who closes Jazz Fest and has played Coachella, Bonnaroo, Lollapalooza, Madison Square Garden, the White House, and the 2025 Super Bowl, with a 2026 summer tour featuring Mavis Staples and Tank and The Bangas.
trombone shorty orleans avenue.exampleTitle: Trombone Shorty & Orleans Avenue: Let's Go Get 'Em Tour

nashville drive.draw: Established CT modern-country band that has opened for nationals (Easton Corbin, LANCo, Thompson Square, Colt Ford, Travis Denning), reached #13 on iTunes new-country downloads in 2015, and plays regional fairs, town concerts, and theaters across CT/NY/NJ/MA.
nashville drive.exampleTitle: New Milford Rock the Block — Nashville Drive

vincent pastore s gangster squad.draw: Celebrity-fronted rock/soul/doo-wop revue led by Sopranos actor Vincent "Big Pussy" Pastore that draws on his name recognition to play casino showrooms (Seminole Casino Coconut Creek), City Winery Philadelphia, Live Nation venues, and headlines an annual birthday bash at Daryl's House.
vincent pastore s gangster squad.exampleTitle: Vincent Pastore's Gangster Squad: Annual Birthday Bash

flor bromley s fiesta global.draw: Flor Bromley is a 2026 GRAMMY nominee (Best Children's Music Album, "Herstory") and 2023 Latin GRAMMY nominee whose bilingual family music airs on SiriusXM Kids Place Live and PBS, and who headlines major venues including Wolf Trap, Caramoor, and JCCC's Midwest Trust Center.
flor bromley s fiesta global.exampleTitle: Dancing at Dusk: Flor Bromley's Fiesta Global

the norm hathaway big band.draw: An 18-piece Swing Era orchestra formed 1999 in North Salem NY, billed as one of the top big bands in the NY-Metro area, with multiple appearances at the world-famous Iridium on Broadway and a Saturday Night Live 100th digital short celebration.

conor hanick.draw: Juilliard faculty pianist with major-hall bookings (Barbican, Cal Performances, Ojai Festival, Caramoor) and national press acclaim (NYT compared him to a young Peter Serkin; Boston Globe named his Cage recital "Best Solo Recital" of 2019).

stewart copeland have i said too much.displayName: Stewart Copeland - Have I Said Too Much
stewart copeland have i said too much.draw: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame drummer of The Police (multi-Grammy winner) on his nationally-touring "Have I Said Too Much" spoken-word/Q&A tour, covered by Consequence, Ultimate Classic Rock, and BraveWords.
stewart copeland have i said too much.exampleTitle: Stewart Copeland - Have I Said Too Much

sex candy.draw: Glastonbury-based '90s cover band with a real regional following (~2,380 Facebook likes, own website/YouTube, active club calendar) known for an energetic, produced show, but no casino/theater/festival or national-opener credits found.

pop 2000 tour chris kirkpatrick of nsync.displayName: POP 2000 Tour (Chris Kirkpatrick of NSYNC, O-Town, BBMAK, Ryan Cabrera, LFO)
pop 2000 tour chris kirkpatrick of nsync.draw: A national 27-date nostalgia package built from genuine chart artists (NSYNC's Chris Kirkpatrick, O-Town's #1 "Liquid Dreams"/"All or Nothing," multi-platinum BBMAK, Ryan Cabrera, LFO's #1 "Summer Girls"), booked into theaters and venues like SeaWorld Orlando, playing Ridgefield Playhouse Jul 17, 2026.
pop 2000 tour chris kirkpatrick of nsync.exampleTitle: POP 2000 TOUR — *NSYNC, O-Town, BBMAK, Ryan Cabrera & LFO

facelift the ultimate alice in chains tr.displayName: Facelift - The Ultimate Alice In Chains Tribute
facelift the ultimate alice in chains tr.draw: Established Alice In Chains tribute with a real regional following (roughly 2.4K-5K Facebook followers), active tour dates on Bandsintown, and a booking at Daryl's House Club, a respected ~300-cap Pawling NY listening room.
facelift the ultimate alice in chains tr.exampleTitle: Facelift - The Ultimate Alice In Chains Tribute

the pop rocks 80 s theme party.draw: CT's premier 80's tribute act with ~6,400 Facebook followers and a Mohegan Sun Wolf Den casino showroom booking, plus a regular circuit of regional venues (Ballard's Block Island, 314 Beer Garden, Woodbury Brewing).

billy the showmen.draw: Founded 1963, billed as one of Connecticut's most enduring R&B/soul bands, a 10-piece with 4-piece horn section that headlines regional concert series (Levitt Pavilion Westport, First Bank of Greenwich, Greenwich Historical Society, CityCenter Danbury) and backed The Chiffons in the '70s-'80s.
billy the showmen.exampleTitle: Danbury CityCenter Summer Concert Series — Billy & The Showman

pet sounds live a tribute to the beach b.displayName: Pet Sounds Live — A Tribute to the Beach Boys
pet sounds live a tribute to the beach b.draw: National touring Beach Boys tribute that plays theaters and listening rooms nationwide (Beacon Theatre, City Winery NYC, Capitol Theatre, Feinstein's) with a full 2026 Ticketmaster-ticketed tour and a full-album Pet Sounds multimedia production.
pet sounds live a tribute to the beach b.exampleTitle: Pet Sounds Live — A Tribute to the Beach Boys

howie day.draw: National singer-songwriter whose platinum single "Collide" hit #20 on the Billboard Hot 100 and #7 on Adult Top 40 (1.5M downloads sold); toured with Dave Matthews Band and Gavin DeGraw and now headlines theaters like Infinity Music Hall.

yachtley crew.draw: National-touring yacht rock headliner with a Wikipedia page, Vegas casino residency (KAOS/Palms), coast-to-coast casino/amphitheater headlining, and major-label deals (Jimmy Buffett's Mailboat, then Earache/Universal) plus a Chris Lord-Alge-produced album.
yachtley crew.exampleTitle: Yächtley Crëw — 'Seas The Night' World Tour

nektar.draw: Nektar is the real English prog-rock band (formed 1969) whose "Remember the Future" reached the US Billboard Top 20 in 1973-74 and sold ~250K copies in Europe; a charting, cult-legendary act still touring internationally 50+ years on, here doing an Ian McDonald / King Crimson tribute set.
nektar.exampleTitle: Nektar — King Crimson & Ian McDonald Tribute Tour

litchfield jazz festival 2026 opening ni.displayName: Litchfield Jazz Festival 2026 — Opening Night Gala (Don Braden & The Litchfield Jazz Fest Dectet)
litchfield jazz festival 2026 opening ni.draw: The Opening Night headliner is Don Braden & The Litchfield Jazz Fest Dectet, a 10-piece of internationally-touring jazz faculty (Braden is an acclaimed saxophonist in his 29th year with the fest and has recorded/performed widely), anchoring the 31st annual Litchfield Jazz Festival, a long-running, well-regarded Connecticut jazz institution.
litchfield jazz festival 2026 opening ni.exampleTitle: Litchfield Jazz Festival 2026 — Opening Night Gala & Don Braden & The Litchfield Jazz Fest Dectet

the british rock show.draw: A classic-British-rock tribute act booked at Daryl Hall's Daryl's House Club in Pawling, a respected regional listening room, but with little independent evidence of a large fan following, casino/theater circuit dates, or national support slots.

direct from sweden the music of abba.displayName: Direct From Sweden — The Music of ABBA
direct from sweden the music of abba.draw: Established national touring ABBA tribute playing US performing-arts theaters (Troy Savings Bank Music Hall, Mount Baker Theatre, Jacksonville's Moran Theater, Chicago Auditorium Theatre), ticketed via Ticketmaster, featuring Swedish singers/musicians from Mamma Mia the musical who have worked with original ABBA members.
direct from sweden the music of abba.exampleTitle: Direct From Sweden — The Music of ABBA

cross purpose.draw: Four-piece roots/rock/blues band (formed 2005) with a steady regional circuit: Hopkins Vineyard, White Silo (Sherman), and the Danbury, Bethel, and New Fairfield summer concert series, plus a Bushnell (Hartford) appearance.
cross purpose.exampleTitle: NF Parks & Rec Summer Concert — Cross Purpose

zarna garg million dollar excuses.draw: National headlining comedian with 2M+ Instagram followers, two streaming specials (Amazon Prime "One in a Billion," Hulu "Practical People Win" which hit #2 on Hulu), a NYT-bestselling memoir, and sold-out theater tours across the US, Europe, India, and the Middle East.

aztec two step 2 0 plays simon garfunkel.draw: Led by Rex Fowler, co-founder of the long-running folk-rock duo Aztec Two-Step (founded 1971, recorded for Elektra Records), the act tours performing arts centers and theaters across the Northeast (Fairfield Theatre Company, Natick TCAN, SOPAC, Towne Crier), giving it a genuine established regional following well beyond a generic tribute.
aztec two step 2 0 plays simon garfunkel.exampleTitle: Aztec Two-Step 2.0 plays The Simon & Garfunkel Songbook

litchfield jazz festival 2026 mainstage.draw: Saturday mainstage of the 31st annual, nationally-regarded Litchfield Jazz Festival features Grammy-nominated saxophonist Jimmy Greene, Grammy-nominated pianist Christian Sands, and trombonist Steve Davis (Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers, 150+ recordings), all top-tier touring jazz artists.
litchfield jazz festival 2026 mainstage.exampleTitle: Litchfield Jazz Festival 2026 — Mainstage Saturday (Jimmy Greene, Steve Davis, Paul Bollenback, Curtis Brothers Trio)

southern desperation.draw: A local Connecticut Southern-rock outfit assembled from members of area bands (Future Tense, The New Desperation, Whitewood) that plays small brewery/bar gigs like Housatonic River Brewing (tickets ~$7.50); no evidence of casino/theater/festival bookings, national support slots, charting, or press beyond local event listings.

desert highway a tribute to the eagles.displayName: Desert Highway — A Tribute to the Eagles

desert highway a tribute to the eagles.exampleTitle: Desert Highway — A Tribute to the Eagles

dokken.draw: Dokken is a platinum-selling, Grammy-nominated 1980s hard rock/metal band (Tooth and Nail, Under Lock and Key, Back for the Attack) that tours nationally and headlines theaters like the 500-seat Ridgefield Playhouse.

bearly dead.draw: Boston-based nationally touring Grateful Dead tribute (est. 2015) with ~17K Instagram followers that plays theaters (Infinity Music Hall, TCAN, Milton Theatre) and Northeast festivals (Wormtown, Strangecreek, Jerry Jam), and has hosted guest sit-ins from members of Tom Petty & the Heartbreakers, Tedeschi Trucks Band, and Slightly Stoopid.

litchfield jazz festival 2026 finale sun.displayName: Litchfield Jazz Festival 2026 — Finale Sunday (Steve Kortyka Sextet)
litchfield jazz festival 2026 finale sun.draw: The Sunday finale caps a marquee 31-year jazz festival whose 2026 bill features nationally-touring jazz artists (Jimmy Greene, Steve Davis, Don Braden), with the finale a "31st Anniversary Brunch" led by NYC saxophonist Steve Kortyka's sextet.
litchfield jazz festival 2026 finale sun.exampleTitle: Litchfield Jazz Festival 2026 — Finale Sunday Jazz Brunch (Steve Kortyka Sextet)

an evening with patty griffin.draw: 2x Grammy winner and 7x nominee (2026 Best Folk Album nominee) with an Americana Music Association Lifetime Achievement award, a national touring headliner whose songs have been covered by Emmylou Harris, Kelly Clarkson, The Chicks and Bette Midler.

art garfunkel what a wonderful world cel.displayName: Art Garfunkel: What a Wonderful World Celebration

art garfunkel what a wonderful world cel.exampleTitle: Art Garfunkel: What a Wonderful World Celebration

the dave matthews tribute band dmtb.draw: The only nationally touring DMB tribute (Buffalo-based, ~29K Facebook likes), with 20+ years and 2,000+ shows across 46 states and 10 countries, regularly playing casino ballrooms (Hampton Beach) and performing-arts theaters (Stadium, Larcom, Raue Center, Cookeville PAC).

atomic habitz ft marcus king chris dave.displayName: Atomic Habitz ft. Marcus King, Chris Dave & MonoNeon

atomic habitz ft marcus king chris dave.exampleTitle: Atomic Habitz ft. Marcus King, Chris Dave & MonoNeon

concerts on the green new milford commis.displayName: Concerts on the Green (New Milford Commission on the Arts series)

danny lipsitz the brass tacks.draw: Headlined Lincoln Center's "Summer For The City" with a 14-piece orchestra to 1,400+ people (2024), sold out Bard's Spiegeltent (2025), and plays Joe's Pub, the Public Theater, and Mohonk Mountain House, though social following is modest (~740 Facebook).

three dog night.draw: Legendary classic-rock hitmakers with 21 Billboard Top 40 singles including #1s "Joy to the World," "Mama Told Me Not to Come," and "Black and White"; still tour nationally through theaters and casinos, headlining a sold-worthy $200+ ticket night at Ridgefield Playhouse.

stephen pearcy the voice of ratt.displayName: Stephen Pearcy: The Voice of RATT
stephen pearcy the voice of ratt.draw: Founder and lead singer of RATT, a 1980s glam-metal band that sold 20M+ records with the platinum hit "Round and Round" (#12 Hot 100) and now tours theaters nationally (Patchogue, Arcada, Ridgefield Playhouse) as "The Voice of RATT."
stephen pearcy the voice of ratt.exampleTitle: Stephen Pearcy: The Voice of RATT

moondance the ultimate van morrison trib.exampleTitle: Moondance - The Ultimate Van Morrison Tribute Show

friends of the brothers with special gue.draw: Allman Brothers celebration act fronted by original ABB drummer and Rock and Roll Hall of Famer Jaimoe plus ABB-pedigree players (Junior Mack, Andy Aledort), playing established theaters/listening rooms (Patchogue Theatre, Sellersville, City Winery NYC, Daryl's House, Infinity) with guests like Warren Haynes and Oteil Burbridge.

todd rundgren.draw: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee (2021) and acclaimed artist/producer headlining theaters across the US and Europe on his 2026 Damned If I Do Tour.
todd rundgren.exampleTitle: Todd Rundgren — DAMNED IF I DO Tour

andrew dice clay.draw: Iconic national headliner comedian (first comic to sell out MSG two nights back-to-back) who tours major casino showrooms and theaters including the Venetian/Palazzo in Las Vegas and Parx Casino.

glenn miller orchestra.draw: The world's longest continuously touring big band (formed 1956), playing ~300 dates a year at theaters and performing arts centers across the US and Europe, with the official band's Facebook page at roughly 47K+ likes.

struggle monkey nmhs class of 1986 reuni.displayName: Struggle Monkey (NMHS Class of 1986 Reunion Show)

struggle monkey nmhs class of 1986 reuni.exampleTitle: Struggle Monkey (NMHS Class of 1986 Reunion Show)

gilbert the party pig.draw: A well-known regional novelty animal entertainment act with local TV news coverage (NBC10, WWLP) and a large social following (37,000+ Facebook likes), but it's a private party/community entertainment act, not a draw comparable to a concert or festival.

veterans appreciation picnic.draw: A small-scale community veterans picnic typical of local town-level appreciation events; no evidence found of significant regional draw, press coverage, or attendance figures specific to the Sherman, CT event.

marty stuart and his fabulous superlativ.exampleTitle: Marty Stuart and His Fabulous Superlatives

third annual parrothead party jimmy buff.exampleTitle: Third Annual Parrothead Party (Jimmy Buffett Tribute) — Jamie's Junk Show

justin hayward the story in your eyes to.displayName: Justin Hayward – The Story in Your Eyes Tour

justin hayward the story in your eyes to.exampleTitle: Justin Hayward – The Story in Your Eyes Tour

blackberry smoke 25th anniversary tour 2.draw: Chart-topping Southern rock band with a #1 Billboard Americana/Folk album (You Hear Georgia) and a Top-5 Current Album Sales chart entry (Be Right Here); regularly plays major festivals including Bonnaroo, Austin City Limits, Glastonbury, and Download UK, with a large devoted global fanbase ('Brothers and Sisters').

shinebox formerly the winnie shins.draw: A local classic-rock cover band at a small brewery circuit; distinct from same-named acts elsewhere (San Diego, Georgia, Montreal party bands), with no independent evidence found of significant regional draw or press for this specific Connecticut act.

capricorn an allman brothers tribute.draw: A well-established Connecticut-based Allman Brothers tribute act with a real regional following, having played notable regional venues including Infinity Music Hall (Hartford & Norfolk) and Seven Angels Theatre, and regularly booked at breweries and theaters across the state.

what it is.draw: A Connecticut-based funk/soul/R&B band with horn-driven arrangements playing the regional brewery circuit; described in venue promotional copy as delivering high-energy shows, but no independent press or notable-venue evidence found beyond local listings.

save the palace sherman players.draw: A fundraiser production by the Sherman Players, a beloved but very small community theater troupe operating in a converted church seating about 100 people; strictly local draw with no regional press or notable attendance figures found.

silent film live music the general with.displayName: Silent Film & Live Music: THE GENERAL with Donald Sosin & Joanna Seaton
silent film live music the general with.draw: Musicians Donald Sosin and Joanna Seaton are described as internationally acclaimed silent-film accompanists who have performed at major festivals including Tribeca, San Francisco, Telluride and Yorkshire, and this is part of Music Mountain's long-running, well-regarded chamber series.
silent film live music the general with.exampleTitle: Silent Film & Live Music: THE GENERAL (Buster Keaton)

unbroken glass friends james taylor caro.displayName: Unbroken Glass & Friends (James Taylor & Carole King Tribute)
unbroken glass friends james taylor caro.draw: A local tribute act performing the songbook of James Taylor and Carole King at a small Sherman venue; no independent web presence, press, or notable venue history was found for this specific act beyond the local listing.
unbroken glass friends james taylor caro.exampleTitle: James Taylor & Carole King Musical Tribute with Unbroken Glass & Friends

not my problem.draw: A regional cover band playing rock/pop/funk/new wave that works a steady circuit of CT bars, breweries, weddings, and private events; solid working act but no evidence of larger venues, press, or major following.

woodbury fall festival.draw: A well-established annual Chamber of Commerce community festival at Hollow Park featuring over 75 local vendors, food trucks, live music, and a pet costume contest; free admission and a recurring fixture drawing steady community turnout, though not major regional press scale.

carl palmer s elp legacy welcome back my.displayName: Carl Palmer's ELP Legacy — Welcome Back My Friends: An Evening With Emerson, Lake, and Palmer
carl palmer s elp legacy welcome back my.draw: Features Carl Palmer, actual surviving member of the legendary prog-rock supergroup ELP (nine RIAA-certified gold albums, ~48-50 million records sold), touring nationally and internationally with video of Emerson and Lake from a sold-out Royal Albert Hall show; explicitly marketed and reviewed as "not a tribute act" but the real band's legacy show.
carl palmer s elp legacy welcome back my.exampleTitle: Welcome Back My Friends: An Evening With Emerson, Lake, and Palmer

the outcrops.draw: NJ-based blues/rock/soul band named "Band of the Year" by The Aquarian (2020), with roughly 3,800+ Facebook followers, who have opened for Grammy-nominated blues artist Alexis P. Suter and shared stages with members of Railroad Earth and the Robert Randolph Band.

strange souls a tribute to the doors.displayName: Strange Souls - A Tribute to The Doors
strange souls a tribute to the doors.draw: An established touring Doors tribute act with nearly 4,900 Facebook followers, professional booking (Frank Kielb Entertainment), and a history of shows at notable venues including the Whisky a Go Go in Los Angeles.
strange souls a tribute to the doors.exampleTitle: Strange Souls - A Tribute to The Doors

the robert cray band all amped up tour 2.displayName: The Robert Cray Band – All Amped Up Tour 2026
the robert cray band all amped up tour 2.draw: Five-time Grammy Award winner, Blues Hall of Fame inductee, and Rolling Stone cover artist with 19+ studio albums and millions of records sold; currently on a major national theater tour with dozens of dates across the US and Canada.
the robert cray band all amped up tour 2.exampleTitle: The Robert Cray Band – All Amped Up Tour 2026

new fairfield fair day.draw: A New Fairfield Parks & Recreation town fair at Memorial Field; a genuine small-town community event with limited online presence and no evidence of significant regional press or attendance figures.

beyond the wall pink floyd tribute.displayName: Beyond The Wall — Pink Floyd Tribute
beyond the wall pink floyd tribute.draw: A regional Pink Floyd tribute act active for over a decade across CT, NY, NJ, and PA, having played notable venues including BB King's and the Highline Ballroom in NYC, plus Danbury Green and city concert series, with a full production including lasers and video.
beyond the wall pink floyd tribute.exampleTitle: Beyond The Wall — Pink Floyd Tribute

ann wilson the voice of heart tripsitter.displayName: Ann Wilson: The Voice of Heart & Tripsitter
ann wilson the voice of heart tripsitter.draw: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee (Heart, 2013) with 35+ million records sold, currently touring nationally and internationally (US, Canada, Japan, Australia) behind a new album, with major press coverage and large theater/casino venues on the tour.
ann wilson the voice of heart tripsitter.exampleTitle: Ann Wilson: The Voice of Heart & Tripsitter

silent film live music the general buste.displayName: Silent Film & Live Music: THE GENERAL (Buster Keaton) — Donald Sosin & Joanna Seaton
silent film live music the general buste.draw: Donald Sosin and Joanna Seaton are internationally recognized silent-film accompanists who have performed at major festivals including Telluride, TriBeCa, and San Francisco, and this recurring Music Mountain series draws steady community audiences for classic Keaton films, though it is a niche chamber-arts program rather than a mass-draw concert.
silent film live music the general buste.exampleTitle: Silent Film & Live Music: THE GENERAL (Buster Keaton) — Silent Film with Live Score at Gordon Hall, Music Mountain, Falls Village, CT

king stingray.draw: King Stingray is an ARIA Award-winning Australian band (Michael Gudinski Breakthrough Artist, 5 ARIA nominations), won the Australian Music Prize, had a #1 triple j track, and has toured supporting Midnight Oil and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard, with upcoming 2026 US festival dates including Sea.Hear.Now and Oceans Calling.
king stingray.exampleTitle: King Stingray — Free Outdoor Concert / Surf Rock at Levitt Pavilion, Westport, CT

welcome back my friends an evening with.displayName: Welcome Back My Friends: An Evening With Emerson, Lake, and Palmer (Carl Palmer's ELP Legacy)
welcome back my friends an evening with.draw: This touring production is led by Carl Palmer, surviving member of the RIAA-certified, multi-platinum progressive rock supergroup ELP (48+ million records sold), presented with the full cooperation of the Emerson and Lake estates and using video footage from a sold-out 1992 Royal Albert Hall show; it plays established theaters nationally with strong reviews, though it is a legacy/multimedia tribute rather than the original full band.
welcome back my friends an evening with.exampleTitle: Welcome Back My Friends: An Evening With Emerson, Lake, and Palmer — Prog Rock Tribute at Ridgefield Playhouse, Ridgefield, CT

the afro semitic experience.draw: A long-running (25+ year) touring jazz/roots ensemble that has played festivals, colleges, and houses of worship across the US, with praise from jazz critic Nat Hentoff and coverage as a distinctive regional/national niche act, though its social following remains modest (under 2,000 Facebook likes) and it is not a mainstream chart act.
the afro semitic experience.exampleTitle: The Afro-Semitic Experience (Concerts on the Green)

unbroken glass friends.draw: No meaningful public profile could be found for this act beyond a listing as a small local duo/band playing a Sherman, CT winery; there is no evidence of notable venues, press, charting, or substantial following.
unbroken glass friends.exampleTitle: James Taylor & Carole King Musical Tribute with Unbroken Glass & Friends

carl palmer s elp legacy welcome back my.displayName: Carl Palmer's ELP Legacy (Welcome Back My Friends: An Evening With Emerson, Lake & Palmer)
carl palmer s elp legacy welcome back my.draw: This is the official touring production led by Carl Palmer, the sole surviving member of the internationally famous prog-rock supergroup ELP (48 million records sold, 9 gold albums), combining live drumming with video footage of Emerson and Lake from a legendary Royal Albert Hall show, and has toured major theaters and arenas across North America with strong critical praise, including from Prog Magazine.
carl palmer s elp legacy welcome back my.exampleTitle: Welcome Back My Friends: An Evening With Emerson, Lake, and Palmer

karaoke lip sync night at housatonic riv.displayName: Karaoke & Lip Sync Night at Housatonic River Brewing
karaoke lip sync night at housatonic riv.draw: This is a recurring participatory karaoke/open-mic style night at a well-regarded but small local brewery venue; the brewery itself has a loyal local following and has been voted Best Live Music Venue by CT Magazine readers, but karaoke night itself is a low-key community activity with no touring act or public performer profile.
karaoke lip sync night at housatonic riv.exampleTitle: Karaoke & Lip Sync Night — Karaoke Night at Housatonic River Brewing, New Milford, CT

new fairfield town fair.draw: A longstanding annual community event (run in the vein of the town's Lions Club carnival tradition) featuring rides, food, and live bands that draws families from New Fairfield and neighboring towns; described locally as one of the most highly anticipated summer events in town, but with no evidence of large-scale regional attendance or press beyond local outlets.
new fairfield town fair.exampleTitle: New Fairfield Town Fair — Family Festival / Fair at New Fairfield community grounds, New Fairfield, CT

karaoke lip sync night.draw: A recurring participatory bar event (not a performing act) at Housatonic River Brewing, part of the venue's regular weekly programming alongside trivia and open mic nights; draw is purely local/community-based with no external act to evaluate.
karaoke lip sync night.exampleTitle: Karaoke & Lip Sync Night — Karaoke Night at Housatonic River Brewing, New Milford, CT

borboletta a tribute to santana.draw: A well-established New England Santana tribute band made up of members from notable touring acts (Kung Fu, Turkuaz, Deep Banana Blackout) that has repeatedly packed the Levitt Pavilion in Westport and performed at Gathering of the Vibes festival, with press describing it as delivering 'a high-energy performance' to an enthusiastic sold-out crowd.
borboletta a tribute to santana.exampleTitle: Borboletta: A Tribute to Santana — Free Outdoor Concert / Santana Tribute at Levitt Pavilion, Westport, CT

already gone a tribute to the eagles ct.displayName: Already Gone - A Tribute to the Eagles (CT/regional act)
already gone a tribute to the eagles ct.draw: A regional Eagles tribute band (distinct from the larger Houston- and Kentucky-based bands of the same name) that plays Connecticut-area venues like Park City Music Hall in Bridgeport and Brookfield's Concerts in the Park series, with a modest social following of only a few hundred Facebook likes, indicating a genuine but small-scale local/regional bar-and-park-circuit act.
already gone a tribute to the eagles ct.exampleTitle: Already Gone - A Tribute to the Eagles — Live Music / Eagles Tribute at Housatonic River Brewing, New Milford, CT

101st bethlehem fair.draw: A 101-year-running traditional Connecticut agricultural fair with strong community following (Facebook page shows 13,534 'were here' check-ins and ~9,855 likes), run by the Bethlehem Fair Society with livestock competitions, rides, and entertainment over a 3-day September weekend.

pat metheny side eye iii.draw: Pat Metheny is a globally acclaimed jazz guitarist with three gold albums, 20 Grammy Awards, 39 additional nominations, and over 20 million records sold worldwide; this Ridgefield date is part of a major national/international tour hitting the Beacon Theatre, Foxwoods, and other marquee venues.

welcome back my friends an evening with.displayName: Welcome Back My Friends: An Evening With Emerson, Lake, and Palmer
welcome back my friends an evening with.draw: This is not a standard tribute act but an officially sanctioned show led by Carl Palmer, the surviving member of the supergroup ELP, presented with the full cooperation of the Emerson and Lake estates and combining live performance with video footage from ELP's legendary 1992 Royal Albert Hall show; ELP is one of the best-selling prog rock groups of all time with over 48 million records sold, and this tour plays major theaters nationwide (Beacon Theatre-tier venues, Ticketmaster/Vivid Seats national listings).
welcome back my friends an evening with.exampleTitle: Welcome Back My Friends: An Evening With Emerson, Lake, and Palmer

already gone a tribute to the eagles.displayName: Already Gone - A Tribute to the Eagles
already gone a tribute to the eagles.draw: This is the New England/Tri-State-based six-piece Eagles tribute band (Mitch Kalmus, Tim McGrath, Mike Canavan, Dave Branning, Mark Gutenplan, Ray DiStephan) with a modest Facebook following of only about 423 likes, playing a 300-capacity local brewery venue alongside other regional cover/tribute acts.
already gone a tribute to the eagles.exampleTitle: Already Gone - A Tribute to the Eagles

ridgefield fall arts festival.draw: A well-established, long-running juried fine arts festival held in Ballard Park featuring 75-100+ juried artists, live music, and food vendors, organized in partnership with the Ridgefield Arts Council and Ridgefield Guild of Artists as a fixture of the town's fall foliage season.

sherman chamber ensemble bluegrass conce.draw: A local nonprofit chamber-music group's free annual outdoor bluegrass jam; a comparable recent installment of this same touring series drew only about 60 attendees, and it's a donation-based community event, not a touring act with national profile.
sherman chamber ensemble bluegrass conce.exampleTitle: Free Bluegrass Concert — Sherman Chamber Ensemble

beautiful the carole king musical a c t.displayName: Beautiful: The Carole King Musical (A.C.T. of CT production)
beautiful the carole king musical a c t.draw: A licensed regional staging of the Tony/Grammy-winning Broadway musical at A.C.T. of CT, an Equity professional 184-seat theater founded by Broadway veterans that has itself earned a Grammy nomination for a cast album and regularly sells out; the source material is a major Broadway hit, but this specific production is a small regional/community theater run, not the national tour or Broadway cast.
beautiful the carole king musical a c t.exampleTitle: Beautiful: The Carole King Musical — A.C.T. of Connecticut, Ridgefield, CT

sherman chamber ensemble bluegrass jambo.draw: A local Sherman, CT-based chamber ensemble with about 600 Facebook followers that puts on an annual free, donation-based outdoor bluegrass jamboree featuring its own musicians and community 'grassroots' friends; no evidence of national touring, charting, or major-venue play.
sherman chamber ensemble bluegrass jambo.exampleTitle: Free Bluegrass Concert — Sherman Chamber Ensemble

john gorka.draw: Nationally recognized folk singer-songwriter dubbed by Rolling Stone as "the preeminent male singer-songwriter of what has been dubbed the New Folk Movement," with a 17-album discography on Red House/Windham Hill, a Kerrville Folk Festival New Folk Award, Billboard folk chart success, and collaborations/tours with artists like Mary Chapin Carpenter, Ani DiFranco, and Nanci Griffith.

new milford apple festival.draw: A free, family-oriented annual town festival on the New Milford Green now in its 5th-6th year, featuring roughly 70 vendor booths, kids' activities, an apple bake-off, and inflatables — a well-liked but modest community event without evidence of major regional press or large documented attendance.

sherman chamber ensemble bluegrass band.draw: A local Sherman, CT chamber music nonprofit whose annual free outdoor bluegrass jam features its own musicians plus 'area musicians' at small venues like a park, clubhouse lawn, or restaurant lawn with limited/BYO seating; its Facebook page has only 612 likes, indicating a small, devoted local following rather than any regional or national draw.
sherman chamber ensemble bluegrass band.exampleTitle: Free Bluegrass Concert — Sherman Chamber Ensemble

9th annual pets in the park danbury.displayName: 9th Annual Pets in the Park Danbury
9th annual pets in the park danbury.draw: A long-running (9th annual) free/low-cost ($3) community pet festival at Candlewood Town Park featuring local vendors, an animal blessing, pet costume contest, and rescue groups, sponsored by local businesses like Caraluzzi's Markets — a well-established recurring local event but modest in scale with no evidence of large regional attendance figures or major press coverage.
9th annual pets in the park danbury.exampleTitle: 9th Annual Pets in the Park Danbury

annual labor day art sale cornwall libra.displayName: Annual Labor Day Art Sale (Cornwall Library Benefit)
annual labor day art sale cornwall libra.draw: A long-running (7th annual) community library benefit art sale that draws local and regional attendees with donated works; organizers call it a 'legendary' and 'highly popular' local tradition, and some past sales have featured donated works attributed to notable historical artists, but it remains a small-town fundraiser rather than a major draw event.

plein air litchfield quick paint competi.displayName: Plein Air Litchfield: Quick Paint Competition & Community Night
plein air litchfield quick paint competi.draw: A rapidly growing juried plein air festival that expanded from a one-day 2024 event with 24-25 artists to a multi-day 2025 festival with 34 artists from 17 states and $8,500 in prizes; regional press calls it 'one of New England's most anticipated cultural celebrations' with growing national reputation among plein air artists, though the free community Quick Paint/Community Night portion is the lower-key public-facing piece of the festival.
plein air litchfield quick paint competi.exampleTitle: Plein Air Litchfield: Quick Paint Competition & Community Night

plein air litchfield hollister house pai.displayName: Plein Air Litchfield: Hollister House Paintings Show & Sale
plein air litchfield hollister house pai.draw: Part of the same expanding Plein Air Litchfield festival, which grew from 24 artists/one day in 2024 to 34 artists from 17 states in 2025 with $8,500 in awards and press describing it as gaining a 'growing national reputation' among plein air painters; the Litchfield Inn show/sale is a satellite exhibition within this broader juried event rather than a separate draw of its own.
plein air litchfield hollister house pai.exampleTitle: Plein Air Litchfield: Hollister House Paintings Show & Sale

annual labor day art sale the cornwall l.displayName: Annual Labor Day Art Sale (The Cornwall Library)
annual labor day art sale the cornwall l.draw: A long-running (7th annual) local library benefit art sale in a tiny Litchfield County town, drawing area residents and collectors over a weekend; described locally as a beloved tradition but with no evidence of regional-scale attendance or press beyond hyperlocal outlets.

sherman chamber ensemble bluegrass band.displayName: Sherman Chamber Ensemble Bluegrass Band (Sherman Town Center)
sherman chamber ensemble bluegrass band.draw: A local nonprofit chamber-music organization's informal bluegrass side-project, performing a free annual outdoor community concert; local news coverage of a similarly-sized sister event noted only about 60 attendees, and the group's Facebook following is modest (612 likes).

sherman chamber ensemble bluegrass band.displayName: Sherman Chamber Ensemble Bluegrass Band (Judy Black Memorial Park, Washington Depot)
sherman chamber ensemble bluegrass band.draw: Same small chamber-ensemble bluegrass side-project performing its annual free outdoor concert at a small-town park; evidence points to a modest, low-key local community draw (comparable sister concert drew roughly 60 people) rather than a regional touring act.

community day at the aldrich contemporar.displayName: Community Day at The Aldrich Contemporary Art Museum
community day at the aldrich contemporar.draw: A free family/community day at a respected, nationally-recognized contemporary art institution in a designated Cultural District; The Aldrich is described as occupying a notable niche in the contemporary art world, though this specific day is a recurring free-admission family program rather than a ticketed blockbuster event.

a weekend in the life.displayName: A Weekend in the Life (Gilmore Girls Fan Convention)
a weekend in the life.draw: Ticketed fan convention run by Decade Days in New Milford, the Connecticut town widely identified as the inspiration for Stars Hollow, drawing national Gilmore Girls fandom with cast guests Sean Gunn and Scott Patterson, panels, photo ops and a vendor marketplace; covered by the Danbury News-Times and regional CT film/TV press, with panel seating sold out in advance.
a weekend in the life.exampleTitle: A Weekend in the Life — Gilmore Girls Fan Convention
